title: Editor: save draft
description: PUT /_portal/editor/pages/<id>/draft -> editor-draft-save-response, or 409 editor-conflict-response when baseRevision is not the page's newest revision. Staff only (401 not_authenticated, 403 forbidden), CSRF required (PLAN §2.3.5, §2.11).

anyOf.description: Newest revision the client loaded; null when the page has none.
